coordinates.object_orientation: Head -Y, tail +Y, up +Z; neutral standing quadruped.

concept.reason: Actual skull multi-view figure already available.

scope: Original whole organism with crownlike frill and broad pointed marginal plates; do not reduce to head.
specimen_basis: TMP2005.055.0001 cranium, Brown & Henderson2015 Fig2. No known postcranial skeleton in this source.

scale.basis: Skull1.57m published approximate, deformation caveat. Body5m is reconstruction working estimate, NOT measured whole skeleton.

diagnostic_targets: Crownlike short frill; seven flattened marginal elements each side plus median P0. P1/P2 large spade-like plates, lateral elements smaller. Not a ring of uniform conical spikes.
Nasal horn dominates two short brow horns.
Broad quadrupedal ceratopsid torso, four weight-bearing legs, beak and tapering tail; body inferred from relatives.
uncertainties: Only cranium documented. Body, jaw, beak, colour, skin and keratin extensions reconstructed.
Specimen deformed; do not copy asymmetry as a living diagnostic trait.
Small skull fenestrae are bone openings, not mandatory holes through living skin.
acceptance_checks: Crown and dominant nose horn clear from front, side and top.
Seven paired marginal positions and median P0 discernible; plates broad and flattened, not a generic spiked frill.
Whole body retained and all limbs connected; no floating neck shield.
handoff_contract: Same localdir maker/QA. Maker COMPLETE fixedhash stops; root asynchronous backup, local-first integration; no maker uploads or cleanup.

maker_profile.geometry: Static palette-only, intentionally faceted closed semantic solids. Original profile lofts for torso, head, limbs and tail; flattened crown plates.
maker_profile.source_editability: Unjoined named parts saved in model.blend before a temporary lossless one-mesh material-group export merge.
maker_profile.palette: Six opaque Principled materials; no texture, external buffer, extension, skin or animation.
maker_profile.origin: Identity root at horizontal center of four-foot support pattern. Flat foot bottoms at Blender Z=0.
